title: orders.job-cancelled.v1
description: One garment of an order was cancelled while the order itself carries on — distinct from orders.order-cancelled.v1 and not a weaker form of it, so a consumer subscribed here has subscribed to exactly the garment it must stop expecting. The deliver_together partners this cancellation releases are deliberately not published: SQ-08's reading that a garment leaving the parcel releases the rest of it is proposed and not confirmed (state-transitions.md section 10), and naming the released set here would freeze an undecided product rule into a v1 contract that only a new major could correct. A consumer re-asks IOrderSnapshotQuery. Only the code travels, never the free-text reason and never the actor.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the cancellation was recorded, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The garment job, ordered behind its orders.garment-job-created.v1 and behind everything else about the same garment.

organisationId.description: The organisation the garment belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch the garment was being made at.

orderId.description: The order the garment belongs to. The order itself is NOT cancelled by this event.

garmentJobNumber.description: The human reference, so a rack tag can be named.

reasonCode.description: The configured cancellation reason, by its code. Never null and never blank, and deliberately not constrained to a fixed set: the vocabulary is branch configuration, reviewed under open decision OD-10 in docs/prd/assumptions-and-open-decisions.md and seeded by issue #34, not an enumeration this contract may freeze. The value in the example file is a placeholder, not a code this system issues, and a subscriber that hard-codes it has hard-coded nothing. Never free text.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
